title: subgraph node settings
description: Runs another behavior graph with its own blackboard, bound by interface parameters and outputs.

ref.description: Catalog ID of the behavior graph.

version.description: Semver range the referenced graph must satisfy (for example ^1.0); absent accepts any version.

params.description: Child interface parameters: literals, { param = "<name>" } build-time references, or { key = "<blackboard key>" } run-time input bindings.

outputs.description: Child output port to parent blackboard key.
